title: UP BOARD CLASS 3 — English | Sentences Types
description: Subject-wise test on Sentences Types (English) for UP BOARD CLASS 3. 50Q.
subject: upbo3-english

questions.question: Which type of sentence tells us something or makes a statement?

options.explanation: Interrogative sentences ask questions.
Exclamatory sentences express strong emotions.
Declarative sentences make statements.
Imperative sentences give commands.

questions.explanation: A declarative sentence is used to make a statement or give information, and it ends with a period (.).
